app.banner.storage: This browser does not let PayLink keep data. Invoices you sign here last only until you close the page: copy each link.
app.banner.framed: This page is shown inside another site. For your safety, payments are locked here: open PayLink in its own tab.
app.update: A new version of PayLink is ready.
wallet.pick.title: Choose a wallet
wallet.pick.lede: Wallets installed in this browser. PayLink never sees your keys: your wallet shows you everything before you approve.
wallet.pick.none: No wallet found in this browser. On a phone, open this page in your wallet's own browser (MetaMask, Rabby, Coinbase Wallet…). On a computer, install a wallet extension, then reload.
wallet.account.title: Your wallet
wallet.disconnectHint: PayLink forgets this wallet on this device. To revoke its access completely, do it in the wallet too.
wallet.switching: Confirm the network in your wallet…
wallet.pending: Your wallet already has a request open: check it, then try again.
chain.notDeployedLong: PayLink v2 is not deployed on {network} yet: invoices cannot be signed or paid there.
create.lede: Create a dollar invoice, sign it in your wallet and share the link. Your client pays from anywhere, *straight to your wallet*. Creating one costs nothing: no gas, no sign-up, no platform fee.
create.step1.title: Sign
create.step1.text: Set the amount and what it is for. Your wallet signs the invoice: no transaction, no gas.
create.step2.title: Share
create.step2.text: Send the link on WhatsApp or any chat, or print the card with its QR code for your counter.
create.step3.title: Get paid
create.step3.text: Your client checks the invoice and pays from their wallet. The dollars go straight to yours; nothing is held in between.
create.head: New invoice
create.noChains: This edition has no network enabled.
create.amountHint: Leave it empty and the payer chooses the amount, like a tip jar.
create.memoHint: Travels inside the link only, never on the network. Anyone you share the link with can read it.
create.seatsHint: The link closes after this many payments, for example tickets or seats.
create.neverConfirm: I understand this link stays payable until I cancel it.
create.sign.title: You are about to sign this invoice
create.sign.note: Your wallet will ask for a signature, not a transaction: it costs no gas and moves no money. Check that it shows the same amount and address.
create.status.signing: Confirm the signature in your wallet…
create.status.done: Invoice signed. Share the link below.
create.error.noToken: No token is available on this network.
create.error.amount: Enter the amount with digits, for example 25.50.
create.error.memoTooLong: The memo is too long: {used} of {max} bytes.
create.error.seats: Enter how many payments, from 2 to {max}.
create.error.never: Tick the box to confirm a link without expiry.
create.warn.openSingle: Any payment, even a cent, uses this link up. Set an amount, or choose Unlimited for a tip jar.
create.warn.noExpiry: This link never expires: cancel it from your ledger when you no longer want payments.
create.warn.unlimited: This link accepts payments until it expires or you cancel it.
create.warn.delegated: Your account delegates its code (EIP-7702). Payers check the signature through the delegate: changing it can make this invoice unpayable.
create.warn.unchecked: Signed offline: the network could not be reached to check your account. The payer's checks will confirm the signature before paying.
ticket.scanSub: In {symbol} digital dollars, from any wallet. The money goes straight to the seller.
ticket.qr: QR code of the payment link
ticket.label: Payment card for {amount}
pay.head: Pay an invoice
pay.voice.bill.kicker: You have an invoice to pay
pay.voice.bill.lede: Compare the amount and the address with what the seller told you. When you approve, the digital dollars go *straight from your wallet to theirs*. PayLink never holds them.
pay.voice.open.lede: This link has no set price, like a tip jar. Type what you want to send and check the address. The dollars go *straight from your wallet to theirs*.
pay.voice.paid.lede: The network has settled it, so *there is nothing left to wait for*. Anyone can verify your receipt, the seller included.
pay.voice.settled.lede: This link has been paid, cancelled or has expired, so it *no longer takes payments*. If you still owe the seller, ask them for a new link.
pay.voice.error.lede: This link is incomplete, was changed, or points somewhere PayLink does not trust. Ask the seller to send it again: *never pay a link that fails its checks*.
pay.voice.offline.lede: PayLink could not reach the network just now. That *says nothing about the link itself*, and nothing has left your wallet.
pay.step1.title: Check
pay.step1.text: The amount, what it is for and the address, grouped by four so you can compare it. Four lights confirm the link itself.
pay.step2.title: Approve
pay.step2.text: Your wallet asks you to approve the payment. It pays the small network fee too.
pay.step3.title: Keep the receipt
pay.step3.text: The terminal prints a receipt that anyone can verify, the seller included.
pay.empty: Paste the payment link you received, or open it straight from your chat.
pay.invalidNext: Ask the seller to send the full link again. Do not type it by hand.
pay.firstPaymentText: confirm it with them, through a channel you trust, before you pay.
pay.route.permit: One signature, then one transaction from your wallet.
pay.route.approve: Two transactions: approve exactly this amount, then pay.
pay.route.signature: One signature; the fee is covered.
pay.route.none: Your wallet cannot pay this link here: no payment method fits this token and account.
pay.assure: Non-custodial: the dollars go straight from your wallet to the address above. Your wallet pays the network fee.
pay.status.simulate: Checking the payment with the network…
pay.status.permit: Sign the permit in your wallet: it allows exactly {amount} {symbol}, once.
pay.status.approveSent: Approval sent. Waiting for the network…
pay.status.confirm: Confirm the payment in your wallet…
pay.status.sent: Payment sent. Waiting for the network…
pay.thanks.text: The dollars are already in the seller's wallet.
pay.note.paid: This invoice has been paid. Thank you.
pay.note.soldOut: This link has taken all its payments.
pay.note.cancelled: The seller cancelled this link. Ask them for a new one.
pay.note.expired: This link has expired. Ask the seller for a new one.
pay.note.self: This is your own invoice: share it with the person who pays you.
pay.error.amount: Enter the amount you want to send, for example 10.
pay.error.balance: Your wallet holds {balance} {symbol}: not enough for this payment.
pay.error.gas: Your wallet has no {coin} for the network fee.
pay.error.receipt: The transaction went through, but its receipt does not check out: {reason}
verify.label: Checks on this link
verify.unknown: Could not reach the network to check.
verify.signature.ok: Signed by the address below. It proves who signed, not who they are.
verify.signature.delegated: Signed through the address's delegated code (EIP-7702).
verify.signature.err: The signature does not match: this link was changed.
verify.network.other: Your wallet is on another network.
verify.contract.err: The contract is not the genuine release. Do not pay.
verify.payable.paidNow: Paid by you just now: this link is now closed.
receipt.voice.lede: This receipt is checked against the network every time it opens: the amount, who paid whom, and when. *Nobody can forge it*, not even PayLink.
receipt.voice.invalid.lede: The network does not confirm this payment. Ask for the transaction link again, and *do not hand anything over* until it checks out.
receipt.voice.offline.lede: PayLink could not reach the network. The receipt is *neither confirmed nor refuted* yet.
receipt.notes.title: Good to know
receipt.notes.provesText: A payment of this amount, from one address to another, through the genuine PayLink contract.
receipt.notes.identityText: Who owns those addresses. A saved contact name is your own label.
receipt.head: Receipt
receipt.empty: Open a receipt link to verify it.
receipt.unreachable: Could not reach {network}. The receipt is neither confirmed nor refuted: try again in a moment.
receipt.label: Payment receipt
details.title: Details
ledger.lede: Every invoice this wallet signed on this device and what it has brought in, *checked against the network*. Copy a link to send it again, or cancel it so it can no longer be paid.
ledger.legend.title: Indicator lights
ledger.legend.open: Live. Anyone with the link can pay it.
ledger.legend.paid: Paid. A one-off invoice closes after its payment.
ledger.legend.overdue: Expired before anyone paid it: follow up with your client.
ledger.legend.closed: Cancelled, expired or full. It can no longer be paid.
ledger.notes.title: Good to know
ledger.notes.deviceText: Invoices live in this browser and in the links you shared. Export the ledger to keep a copy.
ledger.notes.cancelText: It only stops new payments; the dollars you received are already in your wallet.
ledger.head: Ledger
ledger.connect: Connect your wallet to see the invoices it signed on this device.
ledger.empty: No invoices yet. Your first one takes a single signature and no gas.
ledger.emptyFilter: Nothing to show with this filter.
ledger.unreachable: Could not reach {network}: its invoices show as unconfirmed.
ledger.skipped.one: {count} stored invoice could not be read and is hidden.
ledger.skipped.other: {count} stored invoices could not be read and are hidden.
ledger.history: History service connected: totals still come from the network.
ledger.cancel.confirm: Confirm the cancellation in your wallet…
ledger.cancel.sent: Cancellation sent. Waiting for the network…
ledger.cancel.done: Cancelled: this link takes no more payments.
send.lede: Save the receive cards of the people you pay often. Next time, open their card, type an amount and pay: *no address to copy, no typo*.
send.notes.title: Good to know
send.notes.cardText: is a payment link without a set amount: the payer chooses it. It works until its owner cancels it.
send.notes.labelsText: A contact's name stays on this device. The pay page shows it next to the address, so you know who you are paying.
send.head: Contacts
send.empty: No contacts yet. Save someone's receive card to pay them in two taps.
send.name: Name
send.card: Their receive card or payment link
send.cardHint: PayLink checks the link before saving it, and remembers the address it pays.
send.error.name: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
send.error.card: This is not a valid PayLink link for this edition.
send.mineText: Make one link that anyone can pay any amount, print it for your counter, and share it once.
till.lede: Keep this screen facing your counter. When the payment lands, the light turns green and the till chimes: *checked on the network*, not on the customer's phone.
till.notes.title: How the light works
till.notes.armedText: lights green only for a verified payment of that invoice, for its exact amount.
till.notes.cardText: can receive any amount: read the figure on the screen before handing anything over.
till.head: Till
till.connect: Connect the wallet that receives payments to watch them arrive.
till.armHint: Or arm one invoice: open it from your ledger with its Till key.
till.noDeployment: PayLink v2 is not deployed on any network of this edition yet.
till.mismatch: A payment arrived, but not for the armed invoice: {amount} {symbol}.
till.openAmountNotice: Open amount: read the figure before handing anything over.
status.lede: Where PayLink v2 is deployed, whether each contract is the genuine release, and whether the networks and services answer. Read straight from the networks: *nothing here is cached*.
status.notes.title: Release identity
status.notes.releaseText: Every deployment comes from the same init code, hash {initCodeHash}.
status.notes.addressText: Deployed through the CREATE2 factory, the contract lives at {address} on every network.
status.head: Deployments
status.rpc.err: No answer from the network's endpoints.
status.code.unknown: Not checked: the network did not answer.
status.code.noCode: No code at the registry address.
status.code.maskedHash: The code differs from the release.
status.code.immutables: The code was copied from another address or network.
status.relayer.none: Not configured: payers use their own wallet.
status.indexer.none: Not configured: history comes from the network.
status.storage.memory: Refused by the browser: nothing is kept after this page closes.
